column1: # Wire-capture probe list — read by capture.sh (review F-11 remediation).
# - id: unique probe name (no spaces); becomes <id>.json in the capture dir.
# - user: A | B (X-Okapi-User-Id + tenant header) | notenant (tenant header deliberately omitted).
# - expect_legacy / expect_port: HTTP status capture.sh asserts for that side,
#   or * = not yet pinned (recorded in the manifest, cross-run divergence still
#   caught by diff-runs.sh; pin after the first legacy baseline run).
# - path: URL-encoded request path ({DASH} is replaced by the "Migration Board" dashboard id).
# - body: request body for POST/PUT, or - for none. May be deliberately malformed.
# Append new probe rows (filter/perPage/sort matrices, error probes) here — no script change needed.
# D-1: dead legacy endpoint — legacy 500 (NPE), port 404 (route never declared).
# --- Review F-04 probes: kiwt filter / paging / sort matrix (legacy statuses measured by the review) ---
# --- Review F-14 probes: error and header handling (port statuses pinned to the stable
# --- mappings D-22..D-25 / ErrorEnvelopeMatrixIT; legacy statuses pinned from
# D-28: invalid boolean filter — legacy 500 (ConversionFailedException), port coerces garbage to false (200).
# kiwt param leniency for stats/perPage (legacy-identical, no dossier entry): garbage values behave as absent.
# D-24 integrity conflict: duplicates populate.sh's m4gen code; state-neutral on both sides
# (legacy 500 rolls back, port 409 rejects) so listings stay comparable across runs.
# --- R16 probes: F-21 directed parser rows (legacy pins from docs/migration/evidence/r13-legacy) ---
# f21-empty-rhs: parity after the KiwtListing empty-RHS fix — both sides drop the clause, full listing.
# f21-escaped-literal: statuses match, bodies diverge (legacy literal backslash 0 rows; port unescapes) — allowlist D-29.
# f21-unbalanced-paren: legacy 500, port drops the clause (200) — D-30.
# f21-gt-notanumber: legacy 500, port drops the clause (200) — D-30.
# f21-10k-filter: container-level rejection both sides (400); bodies diverge (legacy empty, port error body) — allowlist D-31.
# --- R22 probes: F-26 compound empty-RHS absorption (legacy pins from docs/migration/evidence/r22-legacy-compound) ---
# r22-empty-and-trailing: whole-parameter collapse to code=="alpha&&prefix==" — both sides 200, 0 rows.
# r22-empty-or-paren: paren-stripped collapse to code=="alpha||prefix==" — both sides 200, 0 rows.
# r22-empty-leading: absorbed subject `prefix` is not a generator property — 400 both sides; envelopes differ (allowlist D-32).
# r22-empty-top-unknown: top-level empty RHS on an unknown property — dropped before validation, both 200 full listing.
# r22-empty-dotted-top: dotted-path empty RHS — dropped, no join residue, both 200 full listing.
# r22-empty-not: legacy 500, port drops the parameter (200) — D-32.
# r22-uncoercible-compound: legacy 500, port whole-parameter drop (200) — D-30.
# --- M9 R31/R32 probes: escaped-token + wildcard semantics (legacy pins from
# --- fixture rows created by populate.sh: alpha\&&prefix==, ab_cd, abXcd, ab%cd, ab$2cd) ---
# r31-esc-and-empty: escaped && before empty RHS — ONE raw comparison, matches the discriminator row on both sides (F-38 row 1).
# r31-single-lt-identifier: single < with identifier tail — 400 Invalid property: beta both sides; envelopes differ (allowlist D-32 class).
# r31-single-gt-numeric: single > with non-identifier tail — legacy 500, port drops the clause (200) — D-30.
# r32-contains-pct: non-leading % becomes literal $2 — the ab$2cd fixture row matches on both sides (F-39 row 1, positive proof).
# r32-contains-underscore: _ is a live single-char wildcard in =~ — 3 fixture rows both sides.
# r32-contains-esc-pct: \% is an escaped literal percent — exactly the ab%cd row both sides.
# r32-cieq-pct: =i= is the unwrapped ilike — same broken transform, matches ab$2cd both sides.
# r32-match-pct: match/term passes % through LIVE — every ab*cd fixture row both sides.
# r32-match-multiterm: repeated term parameters — legacy 500 (uncaught), port comma-joins and answers 200 — D-33.
# r32-raw-unencoded-pct: what a naive client that fails to encode '%' actually sends — '%cd' is a
# syntactically valid escape decoding to a non-UTF-8 byte. Legacy Tomcat 9 decodes leniently (200,
# 0 rows); port Tomcat 10.1 rejects at the container (400, platform body) — D-34 (R-VER oracle re-run).
